# writerside.yml

<link-summary>Inputs, secrets and outputs of the reusable workflow Writerside.</link-summary>

```text
Builds and checks Writerside documentation, one job per instance, and hands the web help to
pages.yml as a part of the GitHub Pages site. It deploys nothing itself: a repository has one
Pages site, and pages.yml assembles it from every part of the run.
```

```yaml
jobs:
  writerside:
    uses: davils-com/workflows/.github/workflows/writerside.yml@v1
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `working-directory` | string | `.` | Directory the instances are relative to, relative to the repository root. |
| `instances` | string | empty | JSON array of instances (module directory and instance id), such as ["docs/d"]; empty finds them from every writerside.cfg. |
| `builder` | string | `docker` | docker (JetBrains' builder image directly) or action (JetBrains/writerside-github-action). |
| `builder-image` | string | `jetbrains/writerside-builder` | The builder image without tag. |
| `builder-version` | string | `2026.09.0357` | Tag of the builder image. |
| `checker-enabled` | boolean | `true` | Fail on the errors the build reports (broken links, unknown topics) with JetBrains/writerside-checker-action. |
| `pdf` | string | empty | Name of a PDF export settings file (such as PDF.xml); the PDF becomes part of the artifact. |
| `algolia-enabled` | boolean | `false` | Publish the search index to Algolia (secret ALGOLIA_KEY). |
| `algolia-app-name` | string | empty | Algolia application id. |
| `algolia-index` | string | empty | Algolia index name. |
| `algolia-publisher-image` | string | `registry.jetbrains.team/p/writerside/builder/algolia-publisher:2.0.32-3` | JetBrains' Algolia publisher image; pin it by digest with image@sha256:<digest>. |
| `pages-part-enabled` | boolean | `true` | Hand the web help to pages.yml as the part docs. |
| `runners` | string | `{}` | JSON object of runner labels; Writerside builds on linux. |
| `timeout-minutes` | number | `20` | Timeout of every job. |
| `harden-runner` | boolean | `true` | Run step-security/harden-runner first. |
| `harden-runner-egress-policy` | string | `audit` | audit or block. |
| `harden-runner-allowed-endpoints` | string | empty | Endpoints allowed with the block policy, space separated. |
| `pre-setup` | string | empty | Shell commands run before the build. |
| `artifact-retention-days` | number | `7` | Days to keep the artifacts. |

## Secrets

All secrets are optional.

- `ALGOLIA_KEY`

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `instances` | The built instances as a JSON array. |

## Permissions the caller grants

- `contents: read`
